requirement: Rename job state 'queued' to 'pending_dispatch' safely across a zero-downtime rolling deployment.

oracle.summary: Single-step rename breaks mixed-version rolling deploys: N-1 consumers reject 'pending_dispatch' and N consumers reject already-queued 'queued' messages.
oracle.reproduction: Pass {'job_id': '1', 'status': 'queued'} to new handle_message -> raises ValueError.

disconfirmation_notes: Producer and consumer matching in the same commit does not prevent in-flight N-1/N skew during rolling deploys.
